Perfect! All 303 tests pass. The customer merge feature is complete.

## Summary

Added `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` function to `src/customers.js` that:

- Merges a duplicate customer (fromId) into another customer (intoId)
- Removes the fromId customer from the customers array
- Reassigns all invoices from fromId to intoId
- Returns `ok({ customers, invoices })` with the merged data
- Normalizes both customer IDs before processing
- Never mutates original arrays

**Error handling:**
- Returns `fail('CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND')` if either customer doesn't exist
- Returns `fail('SAME_CUSTOMER')` if both IDs refer to the same customer (after normalization)

Added 15 comprehensive tests covering:
- Basic merge functionality
- Customer removal
- Invoice reassignment
- Error handling (fromId not found, intoId not found, same customer)
- Normalized ID handling (mixed case, whitespace)
- Array immutability
- Multiple invoices from same customer
- Preservation of other customers' invoices
- Case-insensitive same customer detection
